paper_title: A prospective randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, dose-response relationship study to investigate efficacy of fructo-oligosaccharides (FOS) on human gut microflora

pico.outcome: The positive impact of FOS on butyrate-producing bacteria and FOS-mediated increased bacterial diversity reinforces the role of prebiotics in conferring beneficial functions to the host.

intervention_frequency: at least one or more times in intervention phase
supplement: inetervention_period_day changes the unit from months to days.
